method: numerical search with symmetry reduction (group Td): orbit elimination from tensor Gauss-Legendre rules, warm starts from rules of higher degree and from Oh rules, large-neighbourhood search with simulated annealing targeted at a rank-ILP orbit structure; checked numerically in the symmetry-reduced system; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
